title: Galactic onion
caption: The shell galaxy NGC 3923, imaged by the Hubble Space Telescope
celestial: NGC 3923 · constellation Hydra · about 90 million light-years away (source figure)

recognition.text: ESA/Hubble Picture of the Week (an editorial selection, not an audience score).

story: The glowing object in this Hubble image is an elliptical galaxy. It is NGC 3923, which lies in the constellation of Hydra, more than 90 million light-years away. Only a few of its outer shells, faint layers of stars in the galaxy's halo, show up in the picture.

NGC 3923 is a shell galaxy, meaning the stars in its halo are arranged in concentric layers. It has more than twenty of these shells, and they are more subtle than those of other shell galaxies. They are also unusually symmetrical, whereas the shells around other such galaxies tend to be more lopsided.

Shells like these are common around elliptical galaxies, turning up in about one in ten of them, but they have never been seen around a spiral. They are thought to form when a larger galaxy swallows a smaller companion. As the two cores draw together they swing back and forth around a shared centre, and that motion ripples outwards into shells of stars, much as ripples spread across a disturbed pond.
scale: Using the source's listed field of view (3.35 x 3.37 arcminutes) and distance (90 million light years), the frame spans roughly 88,000 × 88,000 light-years. Its light set out about 90 million years before reaching the telescope.

understand.summary: Hubble's Advanced Camera for Surveys observed through two filters, at 606 nm in visible light and 814 nm in the near-infrared. The colour mapping isn't published.
understand.eye: One filter records near-infrared light, just beyond the range of human vision.

explore: Astronomers call this swallowing of one galaxy by another galactic cannibalism, and the shell pattern gives such galaxies an onion-like structure. A version of the image was entered by Judy Schmidt into Hubble's Hidden Treasures image processing competition.
alt: A glowing elliptical galaxy, NGC 3923, with a few faint outer shells of stars.
